items.description: In the rocky grasslands of Azuram, the owls grew so big they started abducting human travelers. Eventually, the travelers got used to it and started using these animals as a means of transport.

items.name: Eksodean Dragoon
items.description: High above Skover’s floating fields, the local creatures had to adjust fast to life in the sky. That’s how the glider-drakes came to be small, friendly dragon pets with soft wings and an easy glide. They flit between the hovering cliffs like playful paper kites, happy to follow anyone who offers a warm hand and a little adventure.

items.name: Enripian Featherbeak
items.description: The two large feathers on the back of the Featherbeaks' wings help them stabilize their flight as they swoop down on their prey. They also play a role in courtship displays: the males with the most colorful feathers are the ones that attract the females.

items.name: Meropsian Wingfish
items.description: Wingfish are truly strange creatures: nature has endowed them with wings for swimming and fins for flying, which, contrary to what one might think, makes them very poor at both.

items.name: Pink Moth
items.description: Moths are fascinating creatures capable of releasing powders with various effects: medicinal, hallucinogenic, soporific, poisonous... You should always avoid touching a moth with your fingers.

items.name: Semeruian Seedbird
items.description: When Seedbirds are hungry, it’s said that they nibble on the tips of their roots and eventually fall to the ground after eating their wings. There, they grow back the following season.

items.name: Skoverial Raccoon
items.description: On the ethereal grounds that soared above Skover, many animal species had to quickly adapt to a newly aerial environment. In other words, raccoons can fly now.

items.name: Skoverian Bat

items.name: Aegis
items.description: Aegis is Chakram’s faithful steed. When Chakram turned his back on humans and pledged his allegiance to the demons, his companion could not bring himself to abandon him and now bears the scars of that betrayal.

items.name: Ebralean Goat
items.description: Humans have tried taking advantage of the goats' spectacular climbing skills. Unfortunately, the poor animals found climbing much harder with humans on their backs.

items.name: Eksodean Crocoboar
items.description: Crocoboars are an endemic species that used to cause many problems. The locals solved this by selling these aggressive creatures as pets across Siagarta.

items.name: Enripian Wolf
items.description: Wolves were trained to sniff out treasures hidden under the debris. Sadly, this one lost the sense of smell after a violent encounter with a skunk.

items.name: Fountrailian Hound
items.description: In the Crimson city of Ramburg, hounds are prized as a status symbol. A deep red robe indicates that the hound's master is a bloodthirsty monster, even by the Crimsons' standards.

items.name: Meridional Hog
items.description: The most efficient way to travel is not to run fast, but to avoid running into foes. In that regard, the intimidating stare of the hog is more useful than the buttontail's sprint.

items.name: Meropsian Crab
items.description: Legend has it that the first crab used as a mount was won by a fisherman during a charades match against a Nepsid. The word to guess was "crab". The match lasted two days.

items.name: Nescentine Leggybug
items.description: Originally bred by farmers to rid their crops of midges, leggybugs eventually grew big enough to be employed as draught animals, and later as recreational vehicles.

items.name: Primevallean Skunk
items.description: Skunks were formerly seen as a nuisance. That was before tamers found out the smell problem could be fixed by feeding them only flowers.

items.name: Sparkling Horsean
items.description: There are very few Horseans left alive in Siagarta. You’d have a better chance of finding a one-legged spider in the wild than a Sparkling Horsean.

items.name: A Darkest Ramburg
items.description:
At last, someone’s addressing me!
These ‘Crimson Rams’ are clearly under attack, and they’ve called in THE expert to exorcise all these demons.

items.name: A Pebble in the Shoe
items.description: Me want revenge. Kill Golcano. Me pay you good.

items.name: Azuram's Most Wanted
items.description: Fields have attracted two sparkling species : a boar and a sprout! May your hunt be thrilling!

items.name: Baywatch
items.description: Do you want to prove you’re ready to enter the plains of Skover? Why don’t you go into the Nepsids’ hideout and take down their leader Nepsilon? You'll recognize it right away: it has a stronger scent than the others.

items.name: Beekeeping Specialist
items.description: And if there's one place in the valley that's dangerous and unsafe, it's Nescent. We need more information about the creatures that live there, at least 60 new pieces of information.

items.name: Bel-Etir's Most Wanted
items.description: I did my research. There are at least 2 sparked creatures in this area that I've yet to encounter: [] and [].

items.name: Biology Intern
items.description:
Let's keep working together, it's clear you have potential.
Your next task will be to show me at least 40 species in your codex. Do you think you can do it?

items.name: Book of Life
items.description: My name is Hilda Lambert, chief encyclopedist of the Pilgrims, and I'm here to study the local fauna. You can help too, if you want. Show me a codex with at least 5 monsters in it, and I'll share my pay with you.

items.name: Botanical Expert
items.description: Go down there and fill your codex with at least 25 entries.

items.name: Catwalk
items.description:
Hey, travelers! I need your help!
Grand Inquisitor Chakram has tasked me with making his next robe!

items.name: Cave Athlete
items.description: Hah, you found me! I was looking at the waterfalls when I slipped, the current swept me away and... actually, that explanation doesn't seem sufficient.

items.name: Cave Story
items.description: I need to take down their chief, Reblochonk. Then, they won’t stop me from taking all the copper I want… I just don’t have any idea how to execute that plan.

items.name: Claw and Order
items.description: As you can see, this place is crawling with ferocious crabs. Why don't you show me you can defend yourself by bringing me one of their clamps? If you can do that, I’ll give you something useful.

items.name: Cloud Athlete
items.description: Hah! You found me. Company is pretty scarce in this part of the sky. Thank you for visiting!

items.name: Deep Space Mine
items.description: Hah! You found me. I've met many Kobolds in here, but almost no humans. The last one I talked to got beat up by a docker soon after.

items.name: Eksod Chapter
items.description: During our absence, the Kobolds have dug tunnels and disrupted the ecosystem. Can you take a moment to study the local fauna and show me 80 entries?.

items.name: Enripit's Most Wanted
items.description: I'm not obsessive. I'm just really focused on finding a sparked Kobold miner and a sparked crab in this region. For science. And sport.

items.name: Explore Tiocha
items.description: Today, the port is underwater, the knowledge is lost and spirits have taken up residence there. Would you be willing to fill out your codex to rediscover Krisomal? Let's say... 40 entries?

items.name: Flower of the Flock
items.description: Gazzer precious Zzealotus for me, pleazze.

items.name: Forest Jump
items.description: Hah! You found me. Can you believe I've spent 2 months up that tree without meeting anyone? It seems people really aren't interested in this part of the forest.

items.name: Gotta Catch One
items.description: Buy a net if you haven't already and try to catch 1 companion!.

items.name: Harvest Season
items.description: Bring me 10 roots, and I’ll give you a recipe in return. You’ll be amazed by the taste of it!

items.name: Heart of the Matter
items.description: In that regard, their heart possesses alchemical properties that might be of interest to an apprentice like myself. Could you bring me 10 Hearts, please ?

items.name: Hidden Critter
items.description: To find it, you'll need to climb the giant tree and go as far west as possible. Then, jump. You'll find a cave carved into the cliff, and inside, the ladybug!

items.name: Looming Shadows
items.description: He attacks anyone who crosses his path and makes no distinction between you and us. If you get rid of Agamemnon, I will reward you generously.

items.name: Meridion's Most Wanted
items.description: Several Sparkling creatures were spotted in this area but two of them have caught my attention: a slime and a bee. Find them and add them to your codex!

items.name: Midwest Priestess

A dark cloud spawns around every 3s in combat, lasting 6s. When you go into the cloud, the censer absorbs the cloud, increasing your movement speed by 30% for 3s.
Once you have absorbed 10 clouds, you can release a hidden power.

items.name: High Voltage
items.description: Consuming Chaincast causes your next Final Combo Attack to critically strike.

items.name: Hive Assault
items.description:
Strikes forward, dealing 62% Strength Physical damage to an enemy and generates a Dart, stacking up to 3 times.

At 3 stacks, your next Hive Assault releases the darts, dealing randomly 70% Intellect Magic damage or 70% Strength Physical damage.

items.name: Hive Bite
items.description: A thrust that deals 42.5% Strength Physical damage to an enemy, healing you and all nearby allies for 15% Faith Health.

items.name: Hive's Sunder
items.description: Performs a strong cleave dealing 100% Strength Physical damage to nearby enemies and reducing their Magic Armor by 30% for 10s.

items.name: Hiveborn Blossom
items.description:
Spins to deal 25% Strength Physical damage to nearby enemies.

You can recast this within the next 4s seconds, with damage increased by 100%.

items.name: Hold the Line
items.description: Damage dealt increased by 3%/6% and damage suffered reduced by 3%/6% while Rage Shield is active.

items.name: Honey Crush
items.description: Smashes the ground and deals 89.5% Strength Physical damage to enemies, knocking them back and generating 2 stacks of Buzzing.

items.name: Hot, hot, hot!
items.description: Conjures a heat zone in the targeted area for 4s. Allies within the zone receive a temporary Flamie for 8s.

items.name: Hunter Net
items.description:
Throws a net in the targeted direction dealing 100% Dexterity Physical damage to the first enemy hit and slowing them by 30% for 4s.
If an enemy is hit, you gain Big Game Hunter.

items.name: Hysteria
items.description:
Each time you deal non-periodic Physical damage to an enemy, you gain a stack of Hysteria.
At 150 stacks, you can release your anger.

items.name: Ignore Pain
items.description: Reduces all damage taken by 60% for 12s.

items.name: Improved Mixture
items.description: Lethal Poison now stacks up to 6/7 times.

items.name: Infernal Plunge
items.description: Jumps behind a target, dealing 60% Dexterity Physical damage. If the target is afflicted by Chaos Mark, consumes it to reset the cooldown.

items.name: Infinite Rage
items.description: While in combat, you generate 1 Rage every 3s.

items.name: Infinite Resources
items.description: While in combat, regenerates 3 Spark point every 2s.

items.name: Infused Wound
items.description:
Your Magic critical strikes apply a sparked version of Hemorrhage for 35% of the damage dealt over 9s.

Benefits from all Hemorrhage-related Talents.

items.name: Infusion
items.description: You can choose a third Conduit.

items.name: Inner Demon
items.description: Your next Weapon Skill has no cooldown but costs you 50% of your remaining Health (30 cooldown).

items.name: Inner Peace
items.description: Your Weapon Skills grant you a Shield absorbing 25% Faith for 8s.

items.name: Intent to Kill
items.description: Gain 5 Combo Points when an enemy affected by your Lethal Poison dies.

items.name: Iron Cyclone
items.description: Charges straight ahead, dealing four times 35% Strength Physical damage to enemies and stunning them for 1s.

items.name: Judgment
items.description:
Releases a nova that activates all ready Prayers.

Each Prayer has its own condition to become ready.

items.name: Kinetic Surge
items.description: Chaincast increases the Physical damage of your next Weapon Skill by 50%.

items.name: Knives Tempest
items.description: Spins and projects knifes around you, dealing 100% Dexterity Physical damage to nearby enemies and generate 1 Combo Point.

items.name: Leeching Poison
items.description: Lethal Poison heals you for 5%/10% of the damage dealt.

items.name: Lethal Dose
items.description: Damage dealt by your poisons increased by 10%/20%.

items.name: Lethal Poison
items.description: Your Attacks have a 20% chance to apply a stack of Lethal Poison, poisoning them for 35% Dexterity Magic damage over 8s, stacking up to 5.

items.name: Life Current
items.description: Any healing effect you provide has a 10%/20% chance to regenerate 2 Spark points.

items.name: Lock and Load
items.description: Shoots an arrow dealing 101% Dexterity Physical damage to an enemy and increasing the damage of your next Weapon Skill by 25% for 15s.

items.name: Luminous Bastion
items.description: Blocking grants you Sunlight.

items.name: Luon flame
items.description: Blasts 160% Faith Magic damage to the target, burning them for 140% Faith Magic damage over 10s.

items.name: Luon Shackles
items.description: Throws a bolt of energy in the targeted direction, dealing 120% Intellect Magic damage to enemies, stunning them for 1.5s and applying a Luon Mark.

items.name: Mad Buzz
items.description:
Dealing and taking damage has a 20% chance to generate a stack of Buzzing, stacking up to 10 times.
At 10 stacks, summons an angry bee that starts attacking enemies for 15s, dealing 80% Faith Magic damage every 3s.

items.name: Magic Conduction
items.description: Magic damage dealt to enemies affected by Hemorrhage increased by 7%/15%.

items.name: Mania
items.description: Smashes the ground and deals 143% Strength Physical damage to enemies, knocking them back and increasing your Cooldown Reduction by 2% for 12s, stacking up to 3 times.

items.name: Master-at-arms
items.description: Your Attacks deal 15%/30% increased critical damage.

items.name: Melting Faith
items.description: Sunlight reduces the Magic Armor and Armor of the enemy hit by 8% for 10s.

items.name: Might of the Executioner
items.description: Your Attacks deal 10%/20% increased critical damage.

items.name: Miracle
items.description: Enter a holy state, granting 50% Cooldown Reduction to Judgment. and making you charge a random Prayer every 1s for 15s.

items.name: Mystic Empowerment
items.description: Grants 30% Cooldown Reduction to allies within 100m for 15s.

items.name: Natural Ascendancy
items.description: Your damage and healing done to a target increase by 2% for each different periodic effect on them, up to 6%.

items.name: Nectar-infused Blade
items.description: Your Attacks deal an additional 12% Faith Magic damage and slow enemies by 70% for 3s.

items.name: Nimble Fingers
items.description: Your Attacks have a 7%/15% chance to reduce the cooldown of your Weapon Skills by 0.5s.

items.name: Noxious Stratagem
items.description: Lethal Poison damage has a 7%/15% chance to reduce the cooldown of your Weapon Skills by 0.5s.

items.name: Opportunity Strike
items.description: Your Basic Attacks applying Lethal Poison have a 50% chance to strike again.

items.name: Oppressive Rays
items.description: Sunlight has a 10%/20% additional chance to critically strike.

items.name: Outburst
items.description: Grants 40% Move Speed Factor and 6% Physical Mastery to allies within 40m for 6s.

items.name: Overload
items.description: Enter an overloaded state, triggering one free random Conduit every 1s for 9s.

items.name: Piercing Light
items.description: Sunlight ignores 50%/100% of Magic Armor.

items.name: Pious Adept
items.description: Magic Mastery increased by 2%/4%.

items.name: Potent Fortitude
items.description: The Shield of Prayer: Virtue increases your Physical Mastery by 15%.

items.name: Power Circuit
items.description: Magic critical strikes increase your chance to land Physical critical strikes by 7%/15% for 6s.

items.name: Power of the Tides
items.description: Using a Skill causes all your active Totems to erupt, dealing 18.75% Intellect Magic damage to nearby enemies.

items.name: Practice Strike
items.description: A thrust dealing 65% Strength Physical damage to an enemy and generating a high amount of threat.

items.name: Prayer: Life
items.description:
Judgment heals for 100% Faith Health.

Becomes ready after you use a Skill of your actual weapon.

items.name: Prayer: Smite
items.description:
Judgment deals 150% Faith Magic damage.

Becomes ready after you use your Final Combo Attack.

items.name: Prayer: Virtue
items.description:
Judgment grants a Shield absorbing 80% Faith damage for 10s.

Becomes ready after you use a Skill of your Arsenal weapon.

items.name: Prodigious Mind
items.description: Your Weapon Skills have a 25% chance to recover 25%/50% of their Spark cost.

items.name: Prosecutor
items.description: Your critical Attacks have a 15%/30% chance to reduce the cooldown of Judgment by 0.5s.

items.name: Psychoactive Petal
items.description: Consumed by Flower Spiral to spin an additional time.

items.name: Purging Strikes
items.description: Your own Sunlight empowers you for 6s, causing all your Attacks to deal an additional 15% Faith Magic damage.

items.name: Pyroball
items.description: Hurls a fire boulder, dealing 140% Intellect Magic damage to an enemy and burning them for 160% Intellect Magic damage over 10s.

items.name: Pyroclasm
items.description: Conjures a fiery eruption in the targeted area, dealing 130% Intellect Magic damage and increasing all Magic damage dealt to enemies by 8% for 15s.

items.name: Queen's Decree
items.description: The next time one of your skills deals Magic damage, it is increased by 100% (30 cooldown).

items.name: Radiance
items.description: Your own Sunlight damage is increased by 12%/25%.

items.name: Radiant Verdict
items.description: Deals 120% Faith Magic damage and stuns nearby enemies for 3s.

items.name: Rage
items.description:
Generates 1 Rage from Attacks and Weapon Skills.
You can spend Rage to use Raging Smash.

items.name: Rage Shield
items.description: When you apply Hemorrhage, you gain a Shield absorbing an amount equal to 5% of your Maximum Health for 8s.

items.name: Raging Smash
items.description: Strikes the ground with rage, dealing 160% Strength Physical damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back.

items.name: Ram Trap
items.description: Drops a spark trap on the targeted area. If an enemy steps on it, they are dealt 100% Dexterity Physical damage, are immobilized for 4s and you gain Big Game Hunter.

items.name: Ram Veil
items.description: Emits bright light around you, dealing 80% Faith Magic damage to nearby enemies and consuming all Benediction stacks. If 5 stacks are consumed, this increases your Crit Chance and Fervor by 5% for 15s.

items.name: Ram's Expulsion
items.description: Punches an enemy with an ancestral power, dealing 100% Dexterity Magic damage and knocking them back a long distance. Enemies in the path are knocked up and dealt 75% of the initial damage.

items.name: Rampage
items.description: Charges your strike up to 3s, then violently smashes the ground, dealing between 250% Strength Physical damage and 600% Strength Physical damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back depending on charge time.

items.name: Red Tempo
items.description: Damage from bleeding effects have a 12%/25% chance to reduce the cooldown of all your Weapon Skills by 1s.

items.name: Regenerating Miasmas
items.description: Heals you for 5%/10% of your Maximum Health when you kill an enemy affected by Lethal Poison.

items.name: Resilience of the Unkillable Demon King
items.description: Your next Final Combo Attack deals 30% increased damage and heal yourself for 50% of the damage dealt (30 cooldown).

items.name: Reverberate
items.description: Consuming Chaincast triggers your Conduits twice.

items.name: Reverse Honey Spin
items.description: Draws all nearby enemies before you, dealing them 40% Strength Magic damage, then slams the ground, dealing 150% Strength Magic damage.

items.name: Righteous Resolve
items.description: Heals nearby allies for 10% Faith Health every 3s while you are surrounded by 2 or more enemies within 6m.

items.name: Riptide
items.description: Splashes a huge water burst in a frontal cone, dealing 90% Intellect Magic damage to enemies.

items.name: Rosary
items.description:
You can add several Prayers to your Rosary. Each Prayer can be selected once.

Prayers have their own condition to become ready and their own effect triggering when you cast Judgment.

items.name: Royal Severance
items.description:
Strikes with both weapons, dealing 50% Strength Physical damage to enemies in a frontal cone and generate a stack of Bladeleaf, stacking up to 2 times.

Using your Signature Skill consumes all stacks and throws them at the nearest enemy, each dealing them 35% Strength Magic damage.

items.name: Scatterbloom
items.description: Throws three sharpened petals dealing 20% Dexterity Physical damage to an enemy. Each Petal has a 35% chance to plant a stack of Ravenous Sprout.

items.name: Scorch
items.description: Quickly casts a fireball dealing 90% Intellect Magic damage to an enemy.

items.name: Scorching Embers
items.description: Casts four fireballs, each dealing 33% Intellect Magic damage to an enemy and increasing the Magic Damage of your next Weapon Skill by 3%. Can stack up to 8 times.

items.name: Searing Furnace
items.description: Quickly casts a fire bolt dealing 100% Faith Magic damage to an enemy, increasing all damage dealt to them by 4% for 10s.

items.name: Seasoned Soldier
items.description: Your Physical critical strikes grant 1 Rage.

items.name: Second Wind
items.description: Damage that should kill you leaves you at 1 Health and grants you the effects of Rage Shield (120 cooldown).

items.name: Sentence
items.description: Strikes with both weapons, dealing 16.5% Strength Physical damage to an enemy and sentencing them to die, increasing all damage you deal to them by 5% for 10s.

items.name: Sever
items.description: Your Weapon Skills deal 20% increased critical damage.

items.name: Shadow Jump
items.description: Teleports yourself behind the target, dealing 120% Dexterity Physical damage and stunning them for 1s.

items.name: Shadowstep
items.description: Teleports behind the target, stunning them for 2s.

items.name: Sharp Mind
items.description: Cooldown Reduction increased by 3%/6%.

items.name: Sharpen Fangs
items.description: Your Attacks and Weapon skills have a 20% to cause the enemies to bleed for 25% Dexterity Physical damage over 9s, stacking up to 5 times.

items.name: Shattered Rage
items.description: When Rage Shield is destroyed, you deal 20% Vitality Physical damage to nearby enemies.

items.name: Shell of the Devourer
items.description:
Your Final Combo Attacks and Attack Blocks grant you a stack of Water Infusion.
At 4 stacks, your next Attack Block is empowered, dealing 250% Faith Magic damage to nearby enemies.

items.name: Shield Bash
items.description: Deals 95% Strength Physical damage to an enemy, stunning them for 1s.

items.name: Shiv
items.description:
Deals 30% Dexterity Physical damage 2 times to nearby enemies.

Your Final Combo Attack resets the cooldown.

items.name: Shiv
items.description: Stabs and deals 60% Dexterity Physical damage to an enemy, triggering the effects of Sharpen Fangs.

items.name: Shockwave
items.description: Heavily slams in a frontal cone, dealing 180% Strength Physical damage and stunning enemies for 3s.

items.name: Sinister Strike
items.description: Strikes with both weapons, dealing 36% Dexterity Physical damage to an enemy.

items.name: Sink to the Bottom
items.description: Delivers a strong punch dealing 30% Dexterity Physical damage to an enemy and reduces the cooldown of one random Weapon Skill by 0.5s.

items.name: Smite
items.description: Deals 42.5% Strength Physical damage to an enemy and generates a stack of Benediction, stacking up to 5 times.

items.name: Smite
items.description: Quickly casts a light bolt dealing 100% Faith Magic damage to an enemy.

items.name: Smoke Bomb
items.description: Drops a smoke bomb at your feet that lasts 8s. Allies inside the cloud dodge all Attacks.

items.name: Smoke Bomb
items.description: Dodges all Attacks.

items.name: Solar Devotion
items.description: You can trigger Sunlight effects without consuming it anymore.

items.name: Soothing Rays
items.description: Sunlight heals for 30% of the damage dealt.

items.name: Soothing Waves
items.description: Heals all allies in the area for 6% Intellect Health every 2s.

items.name: Spark Beam
items.description:
Channels a powerful beam dealing 200% Intellect Magic damage over 1s.
Each tick regenerates 18% Spark.

items.name: Spark Flask
items.description: Refillable Flask regenerates 15/30 Spark points.

items.name: Spark Shield
items.description: Gain a Shield absorbing damage equal to 40% of your Maximum Health. Lasts 60s.

items.name: Spark Shot
items.description: Shoots an arrow dealing 59% Dexterity Physical damage to an enemy plus an additional 25% Dexterity Magic damage if the enemy is under 35% Health.

items.name: Sparkmaster
items.description:
Using a Weapon Skill or your Final Combo Attack consumes Spark.

Consuming Spark activates your Conduits if your gauge is above the threshold.

You can select any combination of Conduits.

items.name: Static Nova
items.description: Blast nearby enemies, dealing 150% Intellect Magic damage and immobilizing them for 4s.

items.name: Stingerang
items.description: Fires a piercing stinger in the targeted direction, dealing 125% Intellect Magic damage to enemies and knocking them back. After 2s, the stinger returns to you, dealing 180% Strength Physical damage on its way back, drawing enemies toward you.

items.name: Summon: Vile Imps
items.description: Summon 2 Vile Imp dealing 20% Intellect Magic damage every 1.5s. Lasts 12s.

items.name: Sun Halo
items.description: Sunlight deals 50% of its damage to nearby enemies.

items.name: Sunlight
items.description: Skills that affect allies empower them for 6s with Sunlight. The next Final Combo Attack consum Sunlight to deal an additional 60% Faith Magic damage.

items.name: Surge of Violence
items.description: Your Final Combo Attack has a 25% chance to allow your next Raging Smash to critically strike and cost no Rage.

items.name: Surging Force
items.description: Sends a shockwave in a frontal cone, dealing 60% Vitality Physical damage and stunning all enemies for 2s.

items.name: Surging Tide
items.description:
Releases two water bolts, each dealing 38.5% Intellect Magic damage to an enemy.
Damage increased by 10% for each active Totem.

items.name: Swarm Lord
items.description:
Your Weapon Skills surround you with an Hive Swarm for 10s.

Hive Swarm deals 12% Strength Magic damage to nearby enemies and heals you for 20% of that amount every 1s.

items.name: Swarmstrike Accord
items.description: Grants a blessing to all allies within 40m, causing all their Attacks to deal an additional 30% Intellect Magic damage for 8s.

items.name: Swift Justice
items.description: Sunlight reduces the cooldown of Weapon Skills by 1s.

items.name: Swift Strike
items.description: Strikes forward, dealing 62% Dexterity Physical damage to an enemy and increasing your Crit Chance by 3%, stacking up to 3 times.

items.name: Swirling Embers
items.description: Surrounds yourself with an embers whirlwind dealing 20% Dexterity Magic damage to nearby enemies every 1s for 8s.

items.name: Tactician Assault
items.description: A thrust that deals 42.5% Strength Physical damage to an enemy with a 30% chance to reduce the cooldown of your Off-Hand Weapon Skill by 3s.

items.name: Tear
items.description: Deals 45% Strength Physical damage to an enemy and resets the cooldown of Bonethrow if this critically strikes.

items.name: Tear Reality
items.description: A huge slash in a cone dealing 150% Strength Physical damage and reducing enemies Armor and Magic Armor by 25% for 15s.

items.name: Temporal Compression
items.description: Each Spark point spent has a 2%/4% chance to reduce the cooldown of your Weapon Skills by 1s.

items.name: Thrill of the Hunter
items.description: Your Weapon Skills' damage mark the enemies for 10s. Your next Attack against them consumes the mark and deal 50% increased damage.

items.name: Tidal Totem
items.description: Summons a Totem at the targeted location, healing allies that stand in the area for 6% Intellect Health every 2s. Lasts 15s.

items.name: Tide Rising Uppercut
items.description:
Unleashes an upward surge of water, dealing 60% Dexterity Magic damage to all nearby enemies.

Using a Skill increases the damage of your next Tide Rising Uppercut by 50%, stacking up to 10 times.

items.name: Tide Warlord
items.description: Your Physical Mastery is increased by 15% while fighting under 50% Health.

items.name: Twin Claws
items.description: Quickly strikes with both hands, dealing 70% Dexterity Physical damage + 70% Intellect Magic damage to an enemy.

items.name: Unstable Goo
items.description:
Magic critical strikes coat enemies in goo for 8s, slowing them by 30%.
Physical critical strikes ignite Goo to deal 168% Intellect Magic damage over 6s.

items.name: Up the Ante
items.description: Cooldown Reduction increased by 3%/6%.

items.name: Urge to Kill
items.description: Finisher has no cooldown and you generate 1 Combo Point every 1s for 10s.

items.name: Veil of the Unkillable Demon King
items.description: As long as all Skills of this weapon are on cooldown, you are permanently protected by a Shield absorbing 70% Intellect damage.

items.name: Venom Infusion
items.description: Your Weapon Skills have a 25%/50% chance to apply Lethal Poison.

items.name: Venomous Finisher
items.description: Finisher always applied Lethal Poison and deals 5% increased damage for each stack.

items.name: Verdant Impetus
items.description: Your Ranged Attacks become bouncing for 6s, dealing 15% increased damage and planting a stack of Ravenous Sprout.

items.name: Virulent Magic
items.description: Excess applications of Lethal Poison will deal 40% Intellect Magic damage.

items.name: Void Bomblets
items.description:
Releases two chaos bolts, each dealing 38.5% Intellect Magic damage to an enemy and applying a stack of Void Bomblet, stacking up to 4 times.

Your Magic Weapon Skills detonate Void Bomblet, dealing 50% Intellect Magic damage per stack.

items.name: Void Fangs
items.description: Spawns 2 void fangs that follow you. Recast the skill to throw a fang and deal 25% Dexterity Magic damage to a target, applying Chaos Mark for 6s.

items.name: Water Veil
items.description: Applying Shields has a 35% chance to heal 30% Faith Health over 6s.

items.name: Wild Whirlwind
items.description:
Spins around for 3s, dealing 35% Strength Physical damage every 0.25s. The last hit knocks enemies back.
You can move freely during the channeling.

items.name: Zeal
items.description:
Your Attacks and Weapon Skills generate a stack of Zeal, stacking up to 10 times.

At 10 stacks, your next Final Combo Attack consums all stacks to reset the cooldown of Zealous Spins and increase its damage by 50%.

items.name: Zealous Fighter
items.description: Your Attacks have an additional 4%/8% chance to critically strike.

items.name: Zealous Spins
items.description: Spins foward, dealing 7.5% Strength Physical damage to enemies thrice on your path. If an enemy is hit, you can recast it within 3s.

items.name: Zealous Warrior
items.description: Fervor increased by 2%/4%.

items.name: Wooden Mortar
items.description: A simple wooden mortar used by Alchemists to craft various potions and elixirs.

items.name: Wooden Wand
items.description: A simple wooden wand used by Enchanters to enchant gear.

items.name: Worn Hammer
items.description: A simple hammer used by Blacksmiths to craft various items.

items.name: Worn Knife
items.description: A simple sharpened knife used by Cooks to prepare delicious meals.

items.name: Worn Pickaxe
items.description: A simple pickaxe used to gather ores from deposits.

items.name: Worn Pliers
items.description: This simple pliers is used by Jewellers to cut beautiful gemstones.

items.name: Worn Scissors
items.description: A simple pair of scissors used by Outfitters to craft various items.

items.name: Worn Sickle
items.description: A simple sharpened sickle used to gather plants.

items.name: Amon Ram, the Creator
items.description: Amon, ram-headed god of creation, appeared to Lady Skover in a vision. No one really believed her story at the time, but it did make the Rams appear more legitimate.

items.name: Apprentice's Grimoire
items.description: At one point, this was an Expert's Grimoire, but all the advanced pages are damaged beyond recognition.

items.name: Beefury, Blessed Blade of the Farseeker
items.description: There is a metaphor at play here: you can see through the blade, but the blade can cut through you. This is the kind of poetry the Apix clan enjoys.

items.name: Book of Mi'Mizan
items.description: Mizan is known for travelling around Merops to learn Naya magic from the Nepsids. No one knows what he did there, but they're no longer taking apprentices.

items.name: Cheese Moon
items.description: Forged in the depths of Irukal, this axe was designed by a people who had never seen a moon in their life, and it shows.

items.name: Clawdius
items.description: At the end of a warrior's arms, these claws look like the gluttonous mouths of two giant snakes.

items.name: Crabgantua's Kneecap
items.description: A creature with three pairs of legs should have more than one kneecap. Crabgantua only had one, but its size and hardness is admirable.

items.name: Credence
items.description: A bow is an object of faith and each arrow is a mystery. Will it hit its target? Will its target hit back? Is there still time for a second shot?

items.name: Dominion
items.description: The best defence is sometimes believed to be attack. Whoever said that has never been hit in the face with a steel shield.

items.name: Flame of Argol
items.description: Burning since before the war of the Four Hundred, this candle is widely regarded as the living soul of the legendary Argol Konda.

items.name: Ghost Clams of the Low Tide
items.description: Before Lord Rulean stole this artifact from the Nepsids, they thought it was responsible for the tides. Luckily, the theft proved that it was in fact useless.

items.name: Glory
items.description: To conquer without risk is to triumph without glory. Thankfully, going to battle with that sword makes such a situation very unlikely.

items.name: Gorgon Ratsay’s Toothpick
items.description: Although the legendary Ratsay used his spear to hunt, cook and eat, this tool was mostly remembered as the first toothpick in Kobold history.

items.name: Horns of the Wind
items.description: This weapon is a testimony to the Rams' lack of imagination. If something can hurt them, they always picture it wearing a pair of horns.

items.name: Ipheion, Star Blossom
items.description: Starflowers are pretty common, but few of them are shooting stars. And even fewer can cut an armor in half.

items.name: Iron Fins of the Leviathan
items.description: Having fins of iron is not necessarily an advantage. In fact, it made the Leviathan slow enough for the fishermen to harvest its precious fins.

items.name: Judgement
items.description: The institutions of justice are rather uncomplicated in Siagarta. This single axe, for instance, cumulates legislative, judiciary and executive power.

items.name: Lady Bee’s Ceremonial Stinger
items.description: In the past, Apix princesses ennobled royal guards using their own stingers, but a series of incidents convinced them to use that spear instead.

items.name: Large Butterfly Net
items.description: This net can be used to try catching world companions.

items.name: Light Practice Sword
items.description: If you've been given this sword, someone thinks you can't be trusted with a real one.

items.name: Magma Mia
items.description: According to legend, this is an overcooked slice of pizza from the Primeval Age. Some scholars pretend it is just cheese. Either way, no one ever managed to eat it.

skills.name: Veil of the Unkillable Demon King

items.name: Pocket Hive
items.description: It's unclear why these specific bees never evolved like their humanoid sisters, but owning one of these tiny hives has become a status symbol for Apix royalty.

items.name: Radiance
items.description: Like a sunbeam hitting the dewy blossoms of the morning, this long wooden beam descends vigorously upon the skulls and noses of the unworthy.

items.name: Ramulus & Ramus
items.description: The purpose of ram horns is to be struck against other horns. For this reason, rams are often represented as twins, so they can strike each other's horns and find purpose in the process.

items.name: Rehearsal Scepter
items.description: This false scepter is materially identical to a real one. But material reality is of little importance when it comes to rituals.

items.name: Rough Shield
items.description: This shield is so rudimentary it usually ends up doing more harm than it prevents.

items.name: Rusty Knives
items.description: These training knives were confiscated from their previous bearer for obvious reasons.

items.name: Thornlace
items.description: A masterpiece of Apix craft, Thornlace is also an expression of the clan's philosophy: beauty is a warning, always laced with danger.

items.name: Twin Fangs of Ratsar
items.description: Like most rodents, Ratsar doesn't have fangs, so he had to steal these. Someday, another toothless creature will probably take them from him too.

items.name: Twin Pillars of Justice
items.description: These weapons have little to do with justice and they certainly aren't pillars, but the Crimson Rams have a taste for metaphors.

items.name: Wingsabers
items.description: The sudden evolution of the bees' appearance triggered a sort of identity crisis, after which they started making all their stuff look like wings.

skills.name: Resilience of the Unkillable Demon King

creatures.name: Alpha Wolf
creatures.description: Wolves get stronger when they eat well, and fiercer when they don't. Somehow, this specimen managed to do both.

creatures.name: Angry Bee
creatures.description: Buzzing around.

creatures.name: Aoyl Golem
creatures.description: During severe storms, Aoyl Golems sometimes break apart, only to be carried away by the wind and reassemble several kilometers away.

creatures.name: Aoyl Sparkle
creatures.description: When people talk about the eye of a storm, they usually mean something like this.

creatures.name: Apix Builder
creatures.description: When the bees discovered that piercing combs and piercing enemy skin were very similar activities, they merged their construction and defense departments.

creatures.name: Apix Defender
creatures.description: Contrary to popular belief, Apix defenders mostly attack.

creatures.name: Apix Harvester
creatures.description: This bee might look abnormally big, but nowadays it's the most normal a bee can get.

creatures.name: Apix Royal Guard
creatures.description: The morphological disparity between bees is not natural: the higher they rank, the more Spark they're allowed to consume, and the more humanoid they get.

creatures.name: Apix Watcher
creatures.description: In Apix vocabulary, "watching" usually also implies "punishing", "slaying" and "making sure humans never come back".

creatures.name: Aromabug
creatures.description: Contrary to what their appearance might suggest, Aromabugs give off a delicious aroma when they die.

creatures.name: Bartlebee
creatures.description: In a clan known for its extreme work ethic, Bartlebee stands out as a notorious slacker. Thankfully, bodyguards aren't supposed to do much anyway.

creatures.name: Beelial
creatures.description: It is rare for a Honeybee to live more than a few months, which makes it rather concerning that the oldest Pilgrim records of Beelial date back decades.

creatures.name: Beet the Maul
creatures.description: Beetroots are known to be bloody, but Maul earned its nickname through repeated, spectacular bursts of rage and violence.

creatures.name: Belzebubbles
creatures.description: Before meeting Belzebubbles, humans thought of "ridiculous" and "fearsome" as two mutually exclusive traits.

creatures.name: Blaze Rascal
creatures.description: According to legend, Rascal's head was set ablaze by excess thinking. As another flaming golem once said: "Cogito ergo soot"

creatures.name: Blob Dylan
creatures.description: Blob's name has become a synonym for freedom and change across the Slimes' Kingdom. They still don't have freedom, and not much has really changed, but at least they have Blob Dylan.

creatures.name: Boar
creatures.description: Boars are misunderstood creatures. Farmers hate them, hunters love them, and they feel the exact opposite.

creatures.name: Boar Burnham
creatures.description: Dwelling inside secluded caverns, Boar sometimes ventures in the outside world to attack a few unsuspecting humans before going back to his quiet life.

creatures.name: Brawler Benoit
creatures.description: Brawler Benoit has spent much of his life in the Crimson Ram Special Forces. However, he recently decided to devote himself to boxing.

creatures.name: Brawler Brahim
creatures.description: Despite his small stature, Brawler Brahim was crowned the grand champion at the Crimson Games.

creatures.name: Brawler Mike
creatures.description: Brawler Mike was accused of biting one of his superiors, but no one ever dared to ask him for details about the incident...

creatures.name: Buttontail
creatures.description: The flowery tail of this hare seems to blossom when they reach adulthood. Its function remains somewhat unclear.

creatures.name: Camel Raminiature
creatures.description: Many people think that Raminiatures eventually turn into Warrams as they grow up. But these two species are cousins, and Raminiatures remain tiny their entire lives. They bring joy to many families.

creatures.name: Captain Druss
creatures.description: Captain Druss wields a two-handed axe like no one else. Some say that if he were to go to war, he could hold a fortress single-handedly.

creatures.name: Captain Ramshackle
creatures.description: Though she got her nickname from the ramshackle ruins the Rams used to live in, this captain kept it because of the terrible yoke she imposes on her subordinates.

creatures.name: Captain Wolfram
creatures.description: The Crimson Rams used to have two problems: wolf attacks and low meat reserves. Now that Wolfram taught them to eat wolves, they have other, more complicated problems.

creatures.name: Carcinos the Proud
creatures.description: Carcinos was once king of the crabs. One would object that crabs don't have a king, but I would answer that it is entirely Carcinos' fault.

creatures.name: Celeryman Pumpkintaro
creatures.description: When he left the outlaw life to settle down as a celeryman, Pumpkintaro had to change his name. The new one isn't perfect, but it is what it is.

creatures.name: Charles Cabbage
creatures.description: Charles is a polymath who knows its onions in all domains of seedling science: sour grapes, hot potatoes and grassroots organizing.

creatures.name: Chase
creatures.description: This hound is part of the Ram Patrol, a group of rescue dogs specially trained to respond to any situation, for the glory of the Crimson Rams. The Ram Patrol is on a roll!

creatures.name: Coyote
creatures.description: Farmers have always avoided raising poultry on the ground because of the presence of hungry coyotes.

creatures.name: Crab
creatures.description: "This is the biggest crab I've ever seen", said the adventurer as an even bigger one approached them from behind.

creatures.name: Crab of the Lost City
creatures.description: "This is the biggest crab I've ever seen", said the adventurer as an even bigger one approached them from behind.

creatures.name: Crab of the Lost City
creatures.description: "This is the biggest crab I've ever seen", said the adventurer as an even bigger one approached them from behind.

creatures.name: Crabgantua
creatures.description: Crabgantua, Creature of the Nepsids, was bred and trained to become a humongous warmount. The first part of the plan was such a success that its tamers got devoured before they could get to the second.

creatures.name: Crimson Archer
creatures.description: At first, the Rams thought it was dishonoring to use long-range weapons. It didn't take them long to decide that defeat was even more dishonoring.

creatures.name: Crimson Beekeeper
creatures.description: Now that the bees have spent five centuries crafting honey with no human interference, beekeeping has become a much tougher job than it once was.

creatures.name: Crimson Brawler
creatures.description: Some soldiers spend their lives perfecting their swordsmanship; others are simply born with stronger knuckles than usual.

creatures.name: Crimson Captain Agamemnon
creatures.description: Agamemnon would have just been a normal captain if it wasn't for his passionate interest in Primeval Age pottery.

creatures.name: Crimson Captain Alex
creatures.description: Alex would be just another captain if it weren’t for his passion for weight training.

creatures.name: Crimson Captain Arthur
creatures.description: Arthur would be just another captain if it hadn’t been for that unfortunate incident involving some goats.

creatures.name: Crimson Captain Ben
creatures.description: Ben would just be a normal captain if it wasn't for his habit to play with the figurines of the strategy table.

creatures.name: Crimson Captain Carmine
creatures.description: Carmine would just be a normal captain if it wasn't for his thwarted artistic ambitions.

creatures.name: Crimson Captain Clover
creatures.description: Clover would just be a normal captain if it wasn't for her alleged spying activities.

creatures.name: Crimson Captain Cynthia
creatures.description: Cynthia might be just one captain among many, but her woodlouse breeding business sets her apart.

creatures.name: Crimson Captain Hector
creatures.description: Hector would just be a normal captain if it wasn't for the unfortunate marriage that made him the butt of countless jokes.

creatures.name: Crimson Captain Joseph
creatures.description: Joseph would be just another captain if it weren’t for his undeniable talent for divination.

creatures.name: Crimson Captain Katy
creatures.description: Katy would be just another captain among many were it not for her penchant for organising pyjama parties.

creatures.name: Crimson Captain Miranda
creatures.description: Miranda would just be a normal captain if it wasn't for her exceptional dancing skills.

creatures.name: Crimson Captain Roger
creatures.description: Roger would be just another captain if it weren’t for his fondness for pineapple pizza.

creatures.name: Crimson Captain Sensabille
creatures.description: Sensabille would just be a normal captain if it wasn't for her persistent hearing problems.

creatures.name: Crimson Colossus
creatures.description: The recruitment test for ogres in the Crimson Ranks is a simple strength test: carrying a ram on each shoulder and climbing the cathedral steps two at a time. Many fail to count the steps correctly.

creatures.name: Crimson Cutpurse
creatures.description: The Crimson Rams have a few deserters in their ranks who are running amok in the sewers of Ramburg, armed to the teeth with butcher knives. If you wander in there, it’ll be your money AND your life.

creatures.name: Crimson Executioner
creatures.description: They say that the strongest soldiers wield the army’s large two-handed axes. But when you ask them about it, they say it’s because there’s less blade to clean after duty.

creatures.name: Crimson Farmhand
creatures.description: Visitors in Skover often wonder why the region's farmers are all part of the Crimson army. After meeting the region's turnips, they usually stop asking questions.

creatures.name: Crimson Plow Hauler
creatures.description: Hauling a plow through the fields is hard, dull, and bad for your joints. But it's more useful than patrolling with the Crimson army.

creatures.name: Crimson Preacher
creatures.description: It's surprising that the Crimson Rams, who lived on a tiny island for most of their history, specialized in the earth magic of Kyre. But don't bring up the subject around them.

creatures.name: Crimson Priest
creatures.description: Once a monk learns to drink beer without spilling it on his robe, he is officially eligible to become a priest.

creatures.name: Crimson Soldier
creatures.description: Not all Crimson Soldiers are violent fanatics, but they all have to act as such and often end up convincing themselves.

creatures.name: Crocoboar
creatures.description: This creature looks like an alligator described by an ancient adventurer who never managed to observe one.

creatures.name: da'Lida
creatures.description: Once the most celebrated singer among spirits, da'Lida still clings to an unattainable dream for an eternal being: to die on stage.

creatures.name: da'Mascus
creatures.description: da'Mascus has always loved the color yellow. That is why he requested a transfer to the Valley of Eternal Autumn.

creatures.name: Dogma
creatures.description: Dogma, hound of the blood moon, is the result of Chakram's tireless attempts to crossbreed the canidae of Niflel and Siagarta. Whether the experiment was a success will be left for its victims to decide.

creatures.name: Draculag, aspiring Nightgod
creatures.description: Draculag dreams of becoming the greatest Nightgod in the history of the Nightlings. A short stay in Siagarta at the Crimson Cathedral should cool his ardor.

creatures.name: Fangandog
creatures.description: The legend of the dancing wolf can be traced back to the Lost Gods Age. No one has ever actually seen a wolf dance, but we always pick one and suggest it might be doing it while no one is looking.

creatures.name: Fiddle Crabstro
creatures.description: Although he's not a real fiddler crab, the "Crab Maestro" is such a galvanizing musician he inspired his kind to revolt against the Nepsids and embrace piracy.

creatures.name: Garlic Hooper
creatures.description: Garlic Hooper has become a role model for many seedlings, embodying "the strong, silent type". Most garlic plants are silent, but not all of them can smell that strong.

creatures.name: Garlic Seedling
creatures.description: Although garlic is known for its many virtues, I would not recommend approaching this creature to anyone who values their health.

creatures.name: Gatsbee
creatures.description: A rare successful outsider within the Apix clan, Gatsbee proved their worth by smuggling royal jelly across the continent.

creatures.name: Gilliver
creatures.description: Gilliver is a traveler. In the current state of Nepsid politics, this courtesy title means he's a warrior looking for people to exterminate and riches to plunder.

creatures.name: Golatea
creatures.description: Although Golatea is made of stone and incapable of speech, its liveliness once captured the heart of famous golem sculptor Magmalion.

creatures.name: Golcano
creatures.description: Golcano has been alive for many centuries. Yet, no one ever taught it yet that drooling magma is bad manners.

creatures.name: Goledeneye
creatures.description: Originally trained by the Kobolds as a deadly, precise and highly controllable weapon, Goledeneye is neither controllable nor precise, but the Kobolds soon learned it was indeed deadly.

creatures.name: Golem
creatures.description: If you break a golem's husk, a new one will start to aggregate around its little Spark soul. It might take a few thousand years, though.

creatures.name: Gorgon's Hollow Golem
creatures.description: In the mutinied mine of Gorgon's Hollow, the golems have organized a strike, and it won't be a surgical one.

creatures.name: Grassflopper
creatures.description: Masters of camouflage, these frogs are largely ignored by carnivorous predators, but have made themselves a target for unsuspecting ruminants.

creatures.name: Great Executioner Léon
creatures.description: As the Grand Executioner of Ramburg, Léon was given the title of Chief Axecutive Officer by their comrades

creatures.name: Green Slime
creatures.description: While most vertebrates use their skulls to protect their viscous organs, slimes have taken the opposite path.

creatures.name: Grill Arson
creatures.description: Known for its fiery words and ardent performances, Arson has become a hot topic in the world of volcanoes.

creatures.name: Gruffy
creatures.description: Gruffy wanted to sail the seas and find treasure. But life as a farmer isn't so bad after all.

creatures.name: Heraclette
creatures.description: Heraclette is known across Irukal for having completed all 12 labours: every job involved in the creation of a great fondue, from aurock farming to Spark mining.

creatures.name: High Inquisitor Chakram
creatures.description: Chakram, Supreme authority of the Crimson Rams, is feared by his followers and trusted by his rivals rather than the opposite.

creatures.name: Honey Mucha
creatures.description: On her spare time, Mucha is an outstanding painter. But her main occupation is to slay fearsome enemies with her trusted blade, and absorb their souls.

creatures.name: Honey Slime
creatures.description: It is possible to drink the slime with a straw and leave its skull defenseless. That's not to say I recommend it.

creatures.name: Honey Zucca
creatures.description: Zucca initially enlisted in the army after noticing how popular the guardians were among worker bees. She now seems to be taking the job seriously, in her own way.

creatures.name: Invoked Oracle
creatures.description: One of the Oracles’ tasks is to make the sun rise every morning. Sometimes, it takes them a little longer, but they’ve always succeeded so far.

creatures.name: Jared Lettuce
creatures.description: Jared's efforts to cultivate a down-to-earth reputation never bore fruit. Ever since his salad days, people have deemed it full of beans.

creatures.name: Jelly Lewis
creatures.description: It is not unusual for slimes to provoke laughter, but this one is the first to do it on purpose. Upon discovering that its talent was best appreciated by humans, Lewis started using it as a distraction to devour imprudent travelers.

creatures.name: Jimmy Crater
creatures.description: Like most craters, Jimmy is mostly recognized by its emptiness.

creatures.name: King Ratsar
creatures.description: Ratsar, First of the Kobold kings to settle in Siagarta, is notoriously driven by his imperishable spite. A sentiment rooted in lactose intolerance as well as human intolerance.

creatures.name: Knight Slime
creatures.description: While Siagarta’s slimes were mostly left to themselves for the last centuries, Niflel’s slimes have spent most of their time around Nightlings, and it shows.

creatures.name: Kobold Crusher
creatures.description: The crushers use their mace for two things: crushing their enemies and flipping the cheese over the fire pit without burning their paws.

creatures.name: Kobold Docker
creatures.description: Is it convenient to be that big when you live in tunnels ? No. Does it make the research of ore any easier ? No. But does it mean your cheese portion is larger ? Also no.

creatures.name: Kobold Miner
creatures.description: Kobolds who leave the Underworld of Irukal often expect to finally enjoy sunlight and fresh air. Sadly, Siagarta’s mines are also underground.

creatures.name: Kobold Overseer
creatures.description: Kobold workers are autonomous enough not to need a supervisor. However, this is not the case for the many creatures the Kobolds exploit in their farms and mines.

creatures.name: Kobold Thief
creatures.description: The Kobolds make their own cheese, collect their own Spark and craft their own machinery. For everything else, they rely on this kind of unilateral trade humans like to call thievery.

creatures.name: Kraba the Sorceress
creatures.description: Kraba is believed by many to turn fishermen into crabs. This claim cannot be verified but it is intimidating, and negatively impacts crab meat consumption in the region.

creatures.name: Krabby Jacob
creatures.description: Krabby is rumored to be a mollusc in disguise. But his very convincing crab shell and even more convincing claw strokes have made this rumor impossible to verify.

creatures.name: Lady Bee
creatures.description: Lady Bee, most humanoid specimen of the Apix clan, aspires to become the most humanoid of all creatures, once the actual humans have been taken care of.

boss.name: Beefury, Blessed Blade of the Farseeker

creatures.name: Lady Borgild
creatures.description: Borgild would do anything to find back her lost lover Liv. Especially murdering people. That's something she would have no second thoughts about.

creatures.name: Lady Zaster
creatures.description: Once a respected Nightlord, Zaster was condemned to exile for trying to spare human conspirators during the Guardian War. As a punishment, her soul was entrapped into an island, whose vegetation is a direct manifestation of Zaster's presence.

creatures.name: Munster Chuck
creatures.description: Chuck, Operator of the Kobolds’ transportation system, is tasked with making sure no cheese cargo gets lost and all human trespassers do get lost.

creatures.name: Naya Sparkle
creatures.description: These creatures have often been confused with urchins, but there are two big differences: these are hundreds of years old, and they will actively try to kill you.

creatures.name: Nepsid Breakwater
creatures.description: This name is a figure of speech. Water can't be broken. But pretty much everything else can be, and you can count on this guy to make sure it is.

creatures.name: Nepsid Fighter
creatures.description: In their native Merops, the exact working title of these individuals is "Diplomatic Representative in Occupied Territory", which means they were sent to kick your butt.

creatures.name: Nepsid Runner
creatures.description: Only people who live underwater would think of “runner” as an impressive name for infantry units.

creatures.name: Nepsid Wavemonger
creatures.description: Wavemongers are credited with transforming Atlantis from a banal human settlement into an immortal legend.

creatures.name: Nepsid Whale
creatures.description: The Nepsids have tried by all means to make gigantism more frequent. However, it only resulted in making their entire population bald.

creatures.name: Nepsid Whale of the Lost City
Nepsilon
creatures.description: Nepsilon, Envoy of Emperor Nephisto in the land of Skover, doesn’t dislike humans personally. She’s just tasked with ensuring all areas previously inhabited by them are now inhabited by Nepsids.

boss.name: Ghost Clams of the Low Tide

creatures.name: Niels Boar
creatures.description: A long-time rival of Al Bearenstein, Niels is reputedly really good at something, but humans have never managed to understand what.

creatures.name: Night Slime
creatures.description: “Keep your eye in the ball”, a wise Night Slime once said.

creatures.name: Nightbringer Invader
creatures.description: Draculag dreams of becoming the greatest Nightgod in the history of the Nightlings. A short stay in Siagarta at the Crimson Cathedral should cool his ardor.

creatures.name: Nightking Maat Demon
creatures.description: Maat Demon was elevated to the rank of Nightking a century ago by the Nightgod Abaddonk himself. With the return of humans to Siagarta, he now leads the Nightlings’ great crusade, determined to send the humans back to Antelimbo, or six feet under, once and for all.

creatures.name: Nightling Patrolfly
creatures.description: Patroflies are, first and foremost, flies, and flies are smashed to bits with a good whack from a slipper : something no self-respecting nightling ever fails to remind his fellow creatures, even if slippers are hard to come by in Niflel.

creatures.name: Nightling Shadow
creatures.description: Preparing excursions to the highworld of Siagarta, Knight Marish trained these soldiers to protect their platoons from light.

creatures.name: Nightling Slayer
creatures.description: Preparing excursions to the highworld of Siagarta, Knight Marish trained these soldiers to protect their platoons from light.

creatures.name: Nightling Subjugator
creatures.description: Some Nightlings have mastered the art of summoning their kind across space and time. Sometimes the summoning fails, and the subject ends up in two places at once. It’s not a pretty sight.

creatures.name: Nightling Terror
creatures.description: Fearing a return of the bloodthirsty humans, Nightling authorities trained these soldiers to scare them away.

creatures.name: Nightlord Asmoderator
creatures.description: The Nightlord Asmoderator is the living proof that longevity is not always synonymous with good health. This Nightlord has been feeling old for over a century now, which is probably why the Crimson Rams managed to "capture" him.

creatures.name: Nightlord Diabloot
creatures.description: Diabloot is said to always carry a considerable amount of various items with him. When he isn't regenerating in Niflel, he is hunted by numerous adventurers in search of rare items.

creatures.name: Nightlord Naamahs'tea
creatures.description: Nightlord Naamahs'tea has always been very polite and a fan of various herbal infusions, which helps him to put into practice the saying ‘Nifel belongs to those who rise early’.

creatures.name: Nightqueen Shaarlize Te'ror
creatures.description: Few Nightladies manage to convince the nightgods to grant them more power; Shaarlize Te'ror almost had to convince them to give her less.

creatures.name: Notorious Bee
creatures.description: Messenger of a generation, Bee is always followed by a cohort of followers known as the Junior M.A.F.I.A (Melliferous Apprentices Following the Idol of Apix).

creatures.name: Onion Seedling
creatures.description: Not many people enjoy the taste of these Onion Seedlings. But they're less dangerous cooked than alive, so we eat them anyway.

creatures.name: Pyrh Sparkle
creatures.description: When youngsters in Siagarta say "this is fire", what they really mean is "run".

creatures.name: Queen Honeyzabeth
creatures.description: Honeyzabeth, Insect queen of Siagarta and mother of all bees in the Apix clan, is said to have claimed as many lives as she has given.

creatures.name: Ram Page
creatures.description: Although he's no longer a page, Ram will forever bear the moniker he earned himself when he accidentally wreaked havoc in a Nepsid camp and miraculously survived.

creatures.name: Ram Stein, the Janitor
creatures.description: The residents of Ramburg can always count on Ram Stein to sing while fixing the elevator if it breaks down.

creatures.name: Ramface
creatures.description: Ramface just wanted the world. And everything in it.

creatures.name: Reblochonk
creatures.description: Since the Kobolds' sports are very similar to their work, Reblochonk is both the best employee under Ratsar's authority and the regional cheese rolling champion.

creatures.name: Red Demodoggo
creatures.description: Despite their cute and playful appearance, Demodoggos are known for devouring the corpses of those who venture into Niflel. The Nightlings train them using bones as sticks.

creatures.name: Red Leggybug
creatures.description: Leggybugs' legs keep growing throughout their lives.

creatures.name: Rice Seedling
creatures.description: When Spark ledges overflow, they permeate the soil and bring crops to life, which usually attracts weak adventurers looking for easy targets.

creatures.name: Royal Jelly Slime
creatures.description: Disguising itself as an Apix larva, this slime managed to get fed by worker bees for several months.

creatures.name: Saladmander
creatures.description: Saladmanders are born in the hearts of lettuce, and unfortunately, the farmer's vegetable garden is often their first meal.

creatures.name: Scummy BlackGill
creatures.description: It's no secret that wanted criminals from all around the 9 worlds often end up hiding in Siagarta. Still, Scummy’s reputation as a corrupt individual is so catastrophic he’s even less popular here than among the Meropian court.

creatures.name: Seed Barrett
creatures.description: Barrett has been called a bad seed by Crimson farmhands, but many seedlings are still rooting for it.

creatures.name: Seed Vicious
creatures.description: Everything vegetables do is out of norm, because they're not supposed to do anything. Except growing, which is the only thing Vicious has stopped doing.

creatures.name: Skunk
creatures.description: One cannot emerge victorious from a fight against a skunk. One can only emerge stinky and shameful, whatever the outcome is.

creatures.name: Skuttle Goldengill
creatures.description: Skuttle is fast on the ground. Skuttle is fast underwater. Skuttle is fast when she jumps into the air. The only thing that's not fast about Skuttle is her cruel killing method.

creatures.name: Smeagolem
creatures.description: Ever since this poor creature found a Kobold's earring in the depths of Enripit, it convinced itself that someone would come and steal that treasure.

creatures.name: Sparkle
creatures.description: This used to be a golem. But millenia of elemental pressure have hardened its crystal heart and destroyed pretty much everything else.

creatures.name: Spirit of Tiocha
creatures.description: Spirits are the Heralds' most devoted servants. But since the War, some have lost their way.

creatures.name: Sponge Blob
creatures.description: Sponge Blob tried to bring some giant fruit shells underwater to use as a new hiding spot. But after getting a craving, he gobbled them all up. Ever since, he’s been hanging out in the cold waters of New Atlaan.

creatures.name: Tidal Totem
creatures.description: All it takes to summon the tidal powers is a handful of fishbones and approximately 6 hours.

creatures.name: Tidal Totem
creatures.description: All it takes to summon the tidal powers is a handful of fishbones and approximately 6 hours.

creatures.name: Tortrock
creatures.description: Tortrocks usually have three stones on their shells. It is said that finding one with four stones brings good luck.

creatures.name: Turnip Arker
creatures.description: In ball games, turnips traditionally played as the ball. That was until Turnip Arker reversed the balance of power.

creatures.name: Turnip Seedling
creatures.description: A farmer who once tried to prepare a broth with live Turnip Seedlings is credited with inventing the first and deadliest bubble bath in history.

creatures.name: ul'Serous, Herald Avatar
creatures.description: ul'Serous, Herald authority of Skover, set out to restore the world's balance by helping the Sunlings make up their lost ground.

creatures.name: Venerer's Hog
creatures.description: Other venerers repeatedly advised her master that training a hog to hunt wasn't a good idea. 10 years later, no one knows where this man is, but his hog is still wreaking havoc in Skover's woods.

creatures.name: Wolf
creatures.description: According to a theory defended by most Crimson scholars, wolves used to be dogs.

creatures.name: Woolybell
creatures.description: The Woolybell's bell grows as they do. It is said that a herd of adult Woolybells makes more noise than a mountain storm.
